description: This file defines API endpoints for managing vector store files, including create, list, retrieve, content, update, and delete operations, using FastAPI. It handles request processing, permission checks, and calls to underlying processing classes.

classes.name: ProxyBaseLLMRequestProcessing
classes.description: A class responsible for processing LLM requests, including handling exceptions and managing request data.

methods.name: _update_request_data_with_litellm_managed_vector_store_registry
methods.description: Updates request data with vector store registry info, such as custom provider and credentials.

methods.name: _resolve_provider
methods.description: Determines the LLM provider from request data, headers, query, or body, defaulting to 'openai'.

methods.name: _maybe_check_permissions
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to access the specified vector store endpoint based on API key metadata.
